items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1957-03-26
items.q: I had a fellow by the name of Fisher who was playing clarinet. He, it was some kind of a, a nail or something on the side of the, uh, advertisement banner.

ctx.x: Did you play much, uh, jobs as advertising? Do much advertising? Plenty.

Fights and balls and stuff like that. Oh yeah, plenty. Plenty advertising wagons for fights and balls and stuff like that. You know. Advertising wagons for football players too. You know, for game football players and all that sort of stuff. Yeah, played lots of advertising wagons. Plenty of them. I'll never forget the day that I played for the, um, John Ruskin Segoe advertisement on Canal Street. I had a fellow by the name of Fisher who was playing clarinet.
